changelog:
Initial release of yoooclaw-work-report-en.

- Automatically extracts daily or weekly work progress, communication points, and to-dos from work-related notifications.
- Supports major work apps: Feishu, DingTalk, Enterprise WeChat, Outlook, Jira, GitHub, Notion, and more.
- Classifies and summarizes notifications into progress, communication, approvals, to-dos, and risks, filtering out non-work noise.
- Generates concise daily or weekly work reports ready to share with team leaders or post on the workbench.
- Customizable through installation: set report type and which apps/groups to follow.
- Multiple output modes: full, simplified, cover-up, and content limits for clarity and brevity.
